links.outcome: Cardiologists' rating of explainability strategies and physician motivation to adopt an explainable AI app
links.effect: 4 of 7 explainability strategies were deemed highly effective and feasible for pilot. The prototype had above-average user experience ratings and motivated adoption through ease of use, reliable information, and explainable functionality.
links.quote: A total of 4 strategies were deemed highly effective and feasible for pilot deployment.

unlisted_practices: Co-design of explainable AI with cardiologists using standardized clinical ECG interpretation
Curating actionable features and setting accurate expectations for AI explanations

screen.reason: Empirical qualitative and design study evaluating cardiologists' interactions and usability with different explainability strategies in an AI application for atrial fibrillation monitoring.
